decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 5 - The habitable room hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes incidental to the residential use of the single-family dwelling known as 48 St.Pauls Close, Hounslow. The building shall not be used for any commercial use or as a separate residential unit.

Condition : 6 - Notwithstanding the details shown in the approved plans and the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995, the existing front wall shall be permanently retained and the existing vehicle access shall not be enlarged or altered.

Condition : 7 - 1.	The proposed change of use from garage to habitable room would be compatible with the character and appearance of the property, would not harm the living conditions of the adjoining occupiers, and would comply with the Council's parking standards. The development therefore complies with adopted Unitary Development Plan policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations), T.1.4 (Car and Cycle Parking and Servicing for Developments) and the Residential Extensions Guidelines.
description: Change of use from garage to habitable room to house
